criterion: `ccmorph context <profile> <model>` with no value prints the token count the session will use, and says whether it was set by hand, found by ccmorph, estimated or left at the default.
evidence: Ran `CCMORPH_LIB_DIR=$PWD/lib uv run --with pytest python -m pytest tests/behaviour_coverage_test.py tests/context_override_test.py -q` after `make shim` → 151 passed. test_context_answers_the_window_the_session_will_use_gh_372 asserts the exact lines 'gw: claude-opus-5 context 1,000,000 tokens · estimated from the model catalogue', 'gw: claude-opus-5 context 500,000 tokens · set by hand', "gw: claude-mystery-9 context 200,000 tokens · left at Claude Code's default", 'ceil: claude-sonnet-5-5 context 300,000 tokens · set by hand' (profile with env.CLAUDE_CODE_MAX_CONTEXT_TOKENS=300000 and a 500,000 pin, the cap a launch runs at) and 'sci: claude-sonnet-5-5 context 100,000 tokens · set by hand' (env ceiling written 1e5). `go test ./cli/ -count=1` ok, including TestEnvCeilingReadsTheHandSetCapAsLaunchDoesIssue372 (300000, 1e5, 100,000 accepted; 0, junk100000, absent rejected). zsh test_context_verb_reads_sets_and_clears_one_models_window and test_context_names_a_model_the_profile_does_not_list PASS.

criterion: The count matches the window line in `ccmorph inspect` for the same profile and model.
evidence: Same pytest run (151 passed). The box test pairs each context line with inspect's window line for the same profile and model: gw → '1,000,000  catalogue-estimate' beside 1,000,000 tokens; gw with a pin → '500,000  manual' beside 500,000; ceil (env ceiling 300000 over a 500000 pin) → inspect window line contains '300,000  manual (env.CLAUDE_CODE_MAX_CONTEXT_TOKENS)' beside 300,000; sci (env ceiling 1e5) → '100,000  manual (env.CLAUDE_CODE_MAX_CONTEXT_TOKENS)' beside 100,000. The ceil/sci inspect assertions failed first ('500,000  manual · compaction target 75%') before cli/inspect.go applied envCeiling(f), the same function context uses. zsh test_context_verb_reads_sets_and_clears_one_models_window pairs 128,000/200,000 with inspect and passes.

criterion: The output names the model and the unit, so a copied line is clear on its own.
evidence: Every asserted line has the shape '<profile>: <model> context <count> tokens · <provenance>', naming the model, the comma-formatted count and the unit 'tokens'. cli/quota_test.go TestContextAnswerNamesTheCountItsUnitAndWhereItCameFromIssue372 pins all four provenance wordings and passes in `go test ./cli/ -count=1`; the pytest box test asserts the full lines for gw, ceil and sci, and the zsh context tests pass.
